$comment: Registry of official sources for every list under data/. Every data file is regenerated from one of these sources by tools/data-pipeline/refresh.ts (CONVENTIONS.md §2). status: download-verified = downloadUrl fetches the artifact directly; landing-verified = landing page confirmed reachable but the download link is versioned per release (manual --local or link scraping needed); verify = URL/API not yet confirmed.

ch/migel.name: Mittel- und Gegenständeliste (MiGeL)
ch/migel.languageLayout: one workbook, one sheet per language (MiGeL D / MiGeL F / MiGeL I)
ch/migel.updateCadence: irregular, typically 1-2 revisions per year (validity 1 Jan / 1 Jul)
ch/migel.notes: Excel download links on the landing page embed the release name (…xlsx.download.xlsx/…) and change each revision. Download manually and run refresh.ts with --local. TODO: landing-page link resolver for auto-download (links use opaque per-release tokens).

ch/analysenliste.name: Analysenliste (AL)
ch/analysenliste.languageLayout: each language edition contains all three sheets (Deutsch / Français / Italiano); one file suffices
ch/analysenliste.notes: Excel download links on the landing page are versioned per release. Download manually and run refresh.ts with --local. TODO: landing-page link resolver for auto-download (links use opaque per-release tokens).

de/diga.name: DiGA-Verzeichnis (digital health applications directory)
de/diga.notes: FHIR API works with a token handshake: POST {"data":{"type":"tokens","attributes":{}}} (Content-Type application/vnd.api+json, Origin+Referer headers) to /api/diga-vz/tokens; send the returned data.id as Authorization: Bearer <id> AND a Referer header on every FHIR request (401 otherwise). Bundles fetched per _profile (HealthApp, HealthAppCatalogEntry, HealthAppManufacturer, HealthAppPrescriptionUnit, HealthAppModule). Live-verified 2026-07-15. Fallback: upstream scripts/scrape-diga.ts.

de/hmv.name: Hilfsmittelverzeichnis (HMV, §139 SGB V)
de/hmv.notes: Normalizer fetches the REST API directly (no downloadUrl). /VerzeichnisTree/<depth> — depth 4 returns the full Gruppe/Ort/Untergruppe/Art hierarchy. With --local pass a directory containing produkte.json + tree.json. Live-verified 2026-07-15.

fr/lpp.name: Liste des Produits et Prestations (LPP)
fr/lpp.updateCadence: roughly monthly (archive number increments per release)
fr/lpp.notes: Normalizer resolves the highest LPP<nnn>.zip from the landing/index page, then downloads via download_file.php?filename=tips/LPP<nnn>.zip. DBF tables parsed with the built-in pure-TS reader (lib/dbf.ts). Live-verified 2026-07-15 (archive 892).

us/hcpcs.name: HCPCS Level II code set (quarterly update)
us/hcpcs.notes: Normalizer resolves the quarterly link (pattern /files/zip/<month>-<year>-alpha-numeric-hcpcs-file.zip) from the landing page. Live-verified 2026-07-15 (July 2026 file). Includes 2-char modifiers (category "modifier").
